text: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed and weak within me [wrapped in darkness]; My heart grows numb within me.
I reach out my hands to You; My throat thirsts for You, as a parched land [thirsts for water]. Selah.
Rescue me, O LORD, from my enemies; I take refuge in You.
In your lovingkindness, silence and destroy my enemies And destroy all those who afflict my life, For I am Your servant.
